subject: How tp obtain sample sheet and annotaion files

messages.author: 97dd7aacdca5ec80
messages.subject: How tp obtain sample sheet and annotaion files
parts:
Thanks for this very nice package!

I am trying to do an analysis for Arabidopsis. I have the expression dataset (downloaded from NCBI) but not the other two files (Sample sheet and annotation) necessary for building CDS object. Is there a way to obtain these files from another source, if this is not available from the paper (supplementary + NCBI-GEO etc.).

Thanks,

RS

messages.author: 027760d088a56515
messages.subject: Re: How tp obtain sample sheet and annotaion files
parts:
Hi RS,

At its most basic, the sample sheet and gene annotations only need to be data frames with 1 column and 1 row (and row names and column names). Hopefully you can find some indication of which genes correspond to which rows of your expression dataset (row names perhaps?), and you can label the cells however you like. So a row of your sample sheet would look something like this:
(row.names - won't have a header)      cells
Cell1                                                     Cell1
Cell2                                                     Cell2

And your gene annotation file would look similar except with gene ids.

Just make sure that the row names of the sample sheet match the column names of the expression matrix and the row names of the gene annotation file match the row names of the expression matrix.

Hope this helps,
Hannah
